tweet.text: It's simple. California does not verify citizenship status. We did the work for them. We obtained the registered voter list and told them who we believe are noncitizens on their rolls. Knowingly processing noncitizen ballots is a federal crime under 18 U.S.C. §§ 611 and 2. We will hold election officials accountable. No one is above the law.

card.title: DOJ gives local California registrars 48 hours to quarantine suspected noncitizen ballots
card.description: In one letter, the DOJ's top Northern California prosecutor gave Contra Costa County’s registrar of voters 48 hours to scour a list of more than 400 voters.
